## Hotels and prices per person

Departure: **28 February to 11 March 2027**, 12 days / 11 nights. All prices are in US dollars. The number of travellers applies to the whole trip. SGL, DBL and TRL indicate room occupancy.

| Hotels | 1 traveller, SGL | 2 travellers, SGL | 2 travellers, DBL | 3 travellers, SGL | 3 travellers, DBL | 3 travellers, TRL |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 3* | $7091 | $5388 | $4175 | $5166 | $3953 | $3802 |
| 4* | $8396 | $6693 | $4950 | $6471 | $4704 | $4485 |
| 5* | $10616 | $8914 | $6150 | $8692 | $5908 | $5421 |

**3-star hotels:** Ker Recoleta, Buenos Aires (2 nights); Solares Del Sur Patagonia, El Calafate (2 nights); Viale Tower, Foz do Iguaçu (2 nights); Nobile Design Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro (3 nights).

**4-star hotels:** 474 Buenos Aires Hotel (2 nights); Calafate Parque Hotel (2 nights); Vivaz Cataratas, Foz do Iguaçu (2 nights); Arena Leme, Rio de Janeiro (3 nights).

**5-star hotels:** DoubleTree by Hilton Buenos Aires (2 nights); Xelena, El Calafate (2 nights); DoubleTree by Hilton Foz (2 nights); Miramar by Windsor, Rio de Janeiro (3 nights).

Every option also includes **2 nights in Ushuaia**. The hotel there is confirmed at booking. Hotels may be replaced with others of the same category.

Flights are charged separately. Private tours with an English-speaking guide in Ushuaia and El Calafate carry a supplement of **$700 per person**, with a minimum of 2 travellers. The optional trip to Martillo Island costs **$300 per person as part of a group** and includes a transfer of about 20 minutes to the port and a boat trip of about 2 hours. The final tour price is confirmed once services and flights have been checked for the booking date.
